selection: Training physical leaves only, Yale canvas, >=70 source boxes, >=8 inferred lines. Exclude every physical leaf in BOUNDARY-CHANNEL-0002 and -0004. Sort by SHA256('BOUNDARY-CHANNEL-0005|' + folio), take first eight. No selected scan downloaded or inspected before freeze.
score: For target t and source s: raw_TM_CCOEFF_NORMED(t,s) minus the arithmetic mean of raw scores for source s against the seven other target scans. Rank sources by this cohort-centered score. No fitted coefficients or thresholds from new scans.
success_gate: All eight correct sources rank first with cohort-centered margin >=0.03 over best wrong source; full own-page top/middle/bottom overlay check; blank/duplicate-target controls. Baseline raw-score ranks also reported. Any miss is failure.
